test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence:
No sooner had she entered the room __when__ the lights went off.
solution:
The correct answer is '**1**' i.e. 'than'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase **"No sooner"** is always followed by the word **"than"**, not "then", "but", or "when".
 
• This structure is used to describe an event that occurs immediately after another event.
 
• The correct construction is: **No sooner + had + subject + past participle + than + subject + verb (past tense).**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"No sooner had she entered the room **than**__ the lights went off."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "then"** is incorrect as "then" indicates a sequence of events and does not fit the grammatical structure.
 
• **Option 3: "but"** is incorrect as it is not used in the construction of "No sooner" sentences.
 
• **Option 4: "when"** is incorrect because "when" does not pair correctly with "No sooner" in formal grammar.
